name: ImagePullBackOff
root_cause: The inventory Deployment was updated to image tag inventory:v2, which does not exist, so the new pod cannot pull its image.
observable_signals: A new inventory pod is in ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff
Pod events report a failed pull of inventory:v2
The previous inventory pod is still serving; the rollout is stalled with an unavailable replica
accepted_remediations: Roll back deployment/inventory to its previous revision
Set the inventory image back to a tag that exists (inventory:dev)
ineffective_remediations: Restart the inventory pod or Deployment: it pulls the same nonexistent tag again
Scale deployment/inventory up: every new replica fails the same image pull
Restart or redeploy other services (orders, gateway): they are healthy, and the old inventory pod is still serving
